title: Cross-source Smart Money data-admission and research-priority matrix
method: Evidence-only synthesis of repository audits through Phase 182; no new vendor request or raw-data download

sources.name: Cboe Options Open-Close
sources.construct: Venue-specific participant-capacity × buy/sell × opening/closing position buckets
sources.history_claim: C1 EOD 2005-01-03; C1 10-minute 2011-01-03; C1 1-minute 2019-10-07; C2/BZX/EDGX EOD 2018-01-02; use 2020-03-01 conservative multi-venue intraday floor pending FAQ/product discrepancy
sources.sample_evidence: Phase 168 EOD: 23,179 rows / 1,553 underlyings / 86 columns; Phase 167 intraday: 123,022 rows / 2,642 underlyings. Samples pass structural checks only.
sources.knowledge_time: Intraday specs say minutes after interval close; exact historical first receipt and immutable archived vintages are unverified. EOD overnight timing is a schedule, not per-file receipt evidence.
sources.revision_semantics: Intraday files are cumulative snapshots; later files can incorporate late trades and remove busts/cancellations. Preserve raw vintages; first differences are changes in published state, not necessarily clock-interval volume.
sources.identity_scope: Cboe venue option-series identity; adjusted deliverables, inactive underlying coverage and effective-dated equity join remain unverified.
limitations: Cboe venues only, not all OPRA
Intraday files omit prices/IV/Greeks/OI
Capacity is not beneficial-owner identity
No exact historical first-receipt archive

sources.name: OptionMetrics IvyDB TradeFlow
sources.construct: OPRA NBBO-signed aggressor flow plus vendor participant-size proxies
sources.history_claim: Advertised from 2016-01; product launched 2026-09-30; 5-minute, 30-minute and EOD aggregates
sources.sample_evidence: No raw multi-year sample or per-symbol/inactive-name sample audited.
sources.knowledge_time: 2016+ backfill is not proof of live availability in 2016. Historical first-receipt logs are absent; never use interval end as vendor knowledge time.
sources.revision_semantics: Correction/vintage policy and historical classifier-version lineage are not verified.
sources.identity_scope: TradeFlow-specific option-series, adjusted-contract and delisted-underlying mappings are not verified.
limitations: Institutional 2 is aggressive-liquidity-demand proxy, not all institutional activity
Institutional 1 is nested in Institutional 2
Retail labels are vendor proxies, not verified beneficial-owner identities
Lot-size fields may have a 2021 start despite 2016 product backfill
One-session vendor classification coverage is not accuracy validation

sources.name: OptionMetrics IvyDB US Open Interest
sources.construct: Daily contract-level outstanding-position state and net OI change
sources.history_claim: Advertised history from 1996-01; US equity/index options; permanent security/option IDs and historical security-name/ticker history including delisted names
sources.sample_evidence: No licensed raw file/patch sample audited in the project.
sources.knowledge_time: Manual describes nightly files and a separate morning OI file; actual historical first receipt is unverified. Option_Price OI has a timing regime break after 2000-11-28.
sources.revision_semantics: Daily patch files can revise prior observations; Phase 147 defines an append-only as-of ledger, but no actual vendor patch chain or receipt archive has been validated.
sources.identity_scope: Permanent IDs and historical ticker history are promising; adjusted contracts, deliverables, and effective stock-universe coverage still require validation.
limitations: OI is not buyer direction, opening volume or participant identity
Only optionable stocks enter the panel
Expiration/exercise/corporate actions can alter OI
Pre/post 2000-11-28 timing regimes must not be blended

sources.name: IVolatility OPRA Signed Flow API
sources.construct: NBBO-signed call/put buys and sells; net premium/delta; midpoint unclassified
sources.history_claim: Advertised history from 2015; minute and daily aggregates; same-evening current delivery claim
sources.sample_evidence: No endpoint-specific raw sample, per-symbol coverage or inactive-name sample audited.
sources.knowledge_time: Same-evening delivery does not establish historical first-publication timestamps for backfilled dates.
sources.revision_semantics: Endpoint-specific correction/vintage policy not disclosed in the audited materials.
sources.identity_scope: Permanent ID, corporate-action and delisted mapping not verified for this endpoint.
limitations: Trade signing is inferred from execution vs NBBO
Midpoint remains unclassified
Trade-condition, stale/locked/crossed quote and complex-order rules incomplete
Retail plans not intended for full-market downloads; professional license required

sources.name: Cboe Volatility Surfaces
sources.construct: Interpolated IV/skew/term-structure context, not trade flow
sources.sample_evidence: Phase 136: four CSV files, 360 rows, one underlying; all timestamps parse, but this is schema-only evidence.
sources.knowledge_time: Calculation timestamp is not publication/receipt time; sample supplied no ETag/Last-Modified or historical receipt evidence.
sources.identity_scope: Broad underlying and inactive/delisted coverage unverified.
limitations: 689 negative extrapolation/flat-lining codes excluded
32 positive confidence cells below 0.5 fail recommended reliability threshold
Single-underlying sample cannot establish universe coverage

sources.name: Databento OPRA trades + TCBBO
sources.construct: Raw OPRA trades with event-synchronous consolidated BBO for independent signing/reconstruction
sources.history_claim: OPRA history from 2023-03-28; 20 options venues in current docs. TCBBO schema introduced in May 2025; strict live-PIT floor no earlier than 2025-05-27 absent delivery evidence.
sources.sample_evidence: No project-held multi-year/inactive-name sample or file-receipt archive audited.
sources.knowledge_time: Pre-2025-05-27 TCBBO backfill is retrospective unless vendor delivery logs prove otherwise; post-cutover first-receipt logs still required.
sources.revision_semantics: Historical correction, replay and vintage policy not fully validated for project use.
sources.identity_scope: OPRA option-series mapping and adjusted-contract/equity identity require effective-dated validation.
limitations: Short strict-PIT window
Pre-2023-03-28 subsampling and no event-synchronous TCBBO
Trade side is inferred; OPRA does not disseminate aggressor side
Licensing/cost and archive completeness not established

sources.name: Cboe Options PITCH
sources.construct: Venue-specific sequenced order lifecycle and depth-of-book messages
sources.history_claim: Advertised historical archive from 2019-10 across C1/C2/BZX/EDGX
sources.sample_evidence: No complete sample, symbol-map or inactive-contract coverage audit in the project.
sources.knowledge_time: Historical first-receipt and archive completeness not verified.
sources.revision_semantics: Sequenced message lifecycle requires replay/gap-recovery validation; project archive/revision policy not established.
sources.identity_scope: Anonymous order IDs and venue-specific symbols; no beneficial-owner identity; effective contract map unverified.
limitations: Venue-specific and anonymous
Order side is not necessarily aggressor/trade side
No proof of complete archived messages or symbol continuity
License and historical delivery costs unknown

sources.name: FINRA ATS / OTC transparency
sources.construct: Delayed aggregate off-exchange volume by symbol/ATS
sources.history_claim: Historical daily/weekly/monthly aggregate products; current source coverage audited in Phases 100-117
sources.sample_evidence: Aggregation reconciliation passed; 1.735% of symbol aggregates revised but revisions represented 10.08% of shares and 11.44% of trades.
sources.knowledge_time: Historical first-publication vintages are not established; eventual revised values cannot be backdated.
sources.revision_semantics: Material revision impact; do not filter on eventual revision status or substitute final values at original publication time.
sources.identity_scope: Historical ticker/security mapping and inactive universe still incomplete.
limitations: Aggregate prints do not reveal buyer/seller beneficial owner
Revision-weighted activity is material
No verified first-publication vintage panel

sources.name: FINRA short-sale volume / short interest
sources.construct: Daily short-sale prints and separately reported settlement short interest
sources.history_claim: Existing Phase 20C panel attempted 2,020 daily files across 335 configured names
sources.knowledge_time: Daily file is published after regular-session close; same-day close execution is invalid. Historical first-receipt coverage remains incomplete.
sources.revision_semantics: Short volume and short interest are different measures and cannot be treated as interchangeable.
sources.identity_scope: Daily time-series coverage incomplete; short-interest universe overlap insufficient for the intended broad stock panel.
limitations: Phase 20C weak/inconsistent pseudo-OOS
H10/H20 mean replacement-minus-blocked negative
H5 median negative and only 5/12 dates positive
No costs/bootstrap in legacy result

sources.name: CFTC TFF / COT
sources.construct: Aggregate futures positioning by reportable trader category; broad market-regime context
sources.history_claim: Public historical reports; index futures, not individual-stock coverage
sources.sample_evidence: Prior Phase 23C panel covered 12 quarterly dates for NASDAQ and S&P 500 futures.
sources.knowledge_time: Prior conservative report-date-plus-six-calendar-day proxy was used; release-time calendar needs exact PIT implementation.
sources.revision_semantics: Historical report revisions and release vintages not fully audited for this strategy.
sources.identity_scope: Index futures only; no direct stock/issuer security identity.
limitations: Phase 23C lacked horizon-specific label maturity embargo
6/12 dates had immature 5D labels; all 12 had immature 20D rows
Prior performance quarantined
Not a stock-level institutional flow signal

sources.name: SEC Schedules 13D / 13G
sources.construct: Beneficial-ownership disclosure events and stated purpose; not transaction-level flow
sources.history_claim: Broad EDGAR history exists; project hash-stratified global sample and legacy cohorts audited
sources.sample_evidence: Phase 179: 497 legacy docs; no verified predecessor edge to an initial filing; two strict A-to-A candidates do not reach initial filings.
sources.knowledge_time: Acceptance timestamps and PAC semantics audited; exact first-public availability is not provided. Conservative next-session use required.
sources.revision_semantics: 13D/A and 13G/A amendments, previousAccessionNumber anchors and PAC messages require separate lineage; current sample is too shallow.
sources.identity_scope: CUSIP and issuer identity mostly recoverable in sample, but no complete effective-dated security master or issuer-level full history.
limitations: 13D and 13G are distinct regimes
Amendments can restate prior information
13F/13D ownership is not transaction flow
Item 4 semantic triage is provisional

sources.name: SEC Form 13F
sources.construct: Quarterly reported long holdings with delayed disclosure
sources.history_claim: EDGAR history; quarterly filings with up to 45-day reporting lag
sources.sample_evidence: Bulk schema has accession and filing date but not accepted time-of-day; accession-level acceptance join required.
sources.knowledge_time: Use accession acceptance time; quarter-end/bulk publication dates are not knowledge times.
sources.revision_semantics: Restatement, add-only and confidential-treatment amendments alter reported state; manager relationships can double count holdings.
sources.identity_scope: 13F list is only partial eligible-security reference; CUSIP effective mapping and shared discretion graph unresolved.
limitations: Long-only and incomplete
No written options or short positions
Delayed and not transaction flow
Confidential treatment and amendments

sources.name: SEC Form 4 insider transactions
sources.construct: Reported insider transactions, requiring transaction-code and derivative/non-derivative semantics
sources.sample_evidence: Prior Phase 21C used six dates; bootstrap advantage intervals crossed zero at H5/H10/H20.
sources.knowledge_time: Acceptance time is required; same-day close execution cannot be assumed.
sources.revision_semantics: Amendments and issuer/security identity must be resolved.
sources.identity_scope: Issuer-symbol and transaction code mapping require effective-dated validation.
limitations: Existing tested buying feature family killed for now
No robust incremental edge over LTM
Historical holdout dates consumed
